findings.message: The Vorbis comment ENCODER field names "Bar Tool 2.0", but the Vorbis comment ENCODER field names "Foo Muxer 1.0"; other software may have rewritten the file, and kept one of them.
The Vorbis comment ENCODER field names "LAME 3.100", which writes MPEG audio, not Speex.
